meta.title: AI Agents — Digital Teammates for Your Business | TenthMatrix
meta.description: AI Agents are digital teammates that take on tasks with clear jobs, rules, and human review. Understand the benefits in plain language with TenthMatrix.
meta.keywords: AI agents, agentic AI, digital teammates, enterprise AI agents, TenthMatrix

header.title: Digital teammates — not another chatbot
header.subtitle: Agents that do work with a job description, boundaries, and an off-switch
header.description: An AI Agent can research, draft, route, or chase follow-ups across your tools. Done well, it feels like hiring a reliable junior colleague — with supervision where the cost of a mistake is high.

overview.title: What an AI Agent actually is
overview.content: Think of an agent as software that can take multi-step actions toward a goal: gather context, propose a next step, and sometimes complete the step — always inside rules you set. It is not magic autonomy; it is structured help.

items.title: Teams drowning in triage
items.description: Support, ops, and sales ops that sort, label, and pass work between systems all day.

items.title: Leaders watching agent sprawl
items.description: Many tools, no owners. You need agents with clear roles, secrets management, and audit trails.

items.title: Builders ready for production
items.description: Pilots that worked in a demo now need promotion, monitoring, and safe credentials.

items.title: Throughput without headcount spikes
items.description: Handle more tickets, leads, or checks without hiring for every surge.

items.title: Fewer dropped balls
items.description: Agents remember the next step and chase it — with alerts when a human must decide.

items.title: Clear accountability
items.description: Each agent has a purpose, owner, and review points — not a mystery script in someone's laptop.

items.title: Safer access to systems
items.description: Short-lived credentials and vaults so agents do not leave permanent keys lying around.

whenRight.title: When agents are the right next step
items: You repeat the same multi-step process every day and volume is rising.
People spend more time moving information than using judgment.
You tried a chatbot and need something that actually completes work — with control.

steps.title: Define the job
steps.description: One clear outcome, success metrics, and what must never be automated without review.

steps.title: Wire the tools
steps.description: Connect only the systems needed — with secrets, identity, and logging from day one.

steps.title: Supervise and scale
steps.description: Start narrow, measure quality, then expand — using promotion and ops practices you can trust.

cta.title: Design your first digital teammate
cta.description: Describe one repetitive multi-step job. We will outline an agent shape, risks, and a sensible pilot.
